critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1050 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, recipes, subscription, admin, push/reminders, water/menu). Approaching the 700-line guideline.
_reminder_tick reads ALL reminder docs every minute (async for over full collection); fine at low scale but should be indexed on user_id or filtered by any-time-matches for larger user base.
_sent_marks is an in-process set (not persisted); with multiple backend workers you could get duplicate push sends. Consider using a TTL Mongo collection or Redis for idempotency across workers.
push_unsubscribe uses only Query(...) for endpoint — some browsers pass very long endpoints; consider accepting via body as well to avoid URL length limits.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a push subscription for admin during subscribe/unsubscribe test. Modified admin reminder 'desayuno' to 08:15 (was 07:42) via PUT /api/reminders during persistence test — not reverted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All PWA + push + reminders features work correctly. Push delivery to real browsers cannot be automated in headless (per instructions), so we only verified /api/push/test returns 200 with {ok:true,sent:N} without 500. VAPID public key is populated in backend env. Service worker registers on the public URL and manifest.json is served.
